note: The session's web search allowance ran out after six searches, so most candidates were looked for only on pages that could be reached directly: their district's, court's or county's own site, party endorsement pages already on file, Wikipedia, and guessed campaign addresses. A blank here means not found that way, not that nothing exists. The Governor's press release pages and one television station's site refused this script (403) and were not used as sources.
